programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is accordionist Mestrinho, seen in performance with Cainã Cavalcante on guitar, Alex Buck on drums, and Carlinhos Noronha on bass. They combine the subtle rhythms of Brazilian music with the leader's instrumental virtuosity.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022 - Fergus McCreadie, Modern
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. One of the bands taking the stage at jazzahead! 2022 is the trio of Scottish pianist-composer Fergus McCreadie. Upon his graduation from the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland in 2018, McCreadie immediately made an impact on the European scene, playing jazz reflecting Scotland’s landscape and musical traditions as well as American and Scandinavian influences. Fergus’s second album ‘Forest Floor’ puts him onto the world stage. Fergus McCreadie appears alongside double bassist David Bowden and drummer Stephen Henderson.

programme.title: Nos barracos da cidade, Concert
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington, Concert
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne, Fusion
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown, Jazz
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love. In 1980 she enrolled at Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School of Music & Art and Performing Arts in New York City, known from the film 'Fame'. During this time, she appeared as an extra in the legendary comedy film 'Ghostbusters'. Musicals and tours with the bands of Diana Ross and Michael Bolton followed.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet, Modern
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, R&B, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976. This broadcast from the North Sea Jazz Archives presents the great Wayne Shorter Quartet. Shorter’s maxim is to reinvent his music during each concert. He means to give his music a radical originality.

programme.title: Richard Bona - Jazz à Vienne, Jazz
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was the wonderful Richard Bona. He conquered the world with his bass and voice a long time ago. Joined on stage by Mike Rodrigues on trumpet, Luisito and Robert Quinteros on percussions, Ozzy Melendez on trombone, and Osmandy Paredes on piano, Bona once again shows why audiences around the world fall for his music.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats, Jazz
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa. In 1974, The Headhunters appeared on German television, playing Palm Grease, Sly, Butterfly, Spank-A-Lee, and Chameleon. Hancock (keys) is joined by Bennie Maupin (saxophones), Paul Jackson (electric bass), Mike Clark (drums) and Bill Summer (percussion).

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival, Modern
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc. In 2018, with guitarist Ricardo Silveira, bassist João Baptista and drummer Kiko Freitas, Bosco introduces us to his trademark melting pot of bossa nova, samba and MPB, sparingly influenced by contemporary jazz. Following his phenomenal successes in his native Brazil, the enthusiasm of the Maltese crowd underlines that João Bosco is now gradually achieving his long-overdue recognition elsewhere.

programme.title: I Wouldn't Give a Cripple Crab a Crutch, Concert
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of Time After Time and You Don't Know What Love Is", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively. Revel in Frank Sinatra's iconic version of I've Got You Under My Skin". Immerse yourself in Dizzy Gillespie's dynamic performance of Let Me Outta Here, recorded live in Denmark in 1970. Enjoy Tony Bennett's unforgettable performance of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) at London’s majestic Royal Albert Hall in 1974. Let the haunting beauty of Nat King Cole's 1957 performance of Autumn Leaves and Louis Armstrong's performance of Basin Street Blues from 1959 delight you. Dean Martin’s smooth vocal stylings will enthrall you as he performs the jazz standard Wrap Your Troubles In Dreams". Witness the electrifying energy of Sammy Davis Jr.'s performance of Too Close For Comfort. Join us for this unforgettable musical experience that you'll surely cherish!

programme.title: Tribute to Gilberto Gil - Da Pá Virada Sessions, Jazz
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Caixa Cubo. This trio usually explores Brazil's rhythmically rich landscapes, combining them with modern Brazilian jazz trends. Yet in this singular performance, Caixa Cubo teams up with vocalist Zé Leônidas, selecting special repertoire together with Dani Gurgel from Da Pá Virada Sessions and Rokas Kučinskas from Stingray DJAZZ.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano, Fusion
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet. He’s also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner’s style is easily comparable to Coltrane’s maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane’s group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane’s open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane’s death.

programme.title: Gregory Porter and Metronomy - Paris, Modern
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time. From David Bowie and Iggy Pop to Pink Floyd and Chet Baker, countless stars recorded unforgettable music here until the studio closed in the 1980s. Three decades later, Château d'Hérouville has reopened its doors. This program follows American baritone Gregory Porter as he collaborates with the British electro-pop band Metronomy. The former American football player, who later dedicated himself entirely to music, gives an interview at Hérouville and performs songs including ‘Don't Loose Your Steam’, ‘In Fashion’, and ‘Sunny’. The British band Metronomy contributes songs such as ‘The Look’, ‘Night Owl’, and ‘Mick Slow’. Metronomy consists of Joseph Mount (drums), Oscar Cash (saxophone, keys), and Michael Lovett (keys). Gregory Porter’s own band consists of Lakecia Benjamin (saxophone), Chip Crawford (piano), Jahmal Nichols (bass guitar), and Emanuel Harrold (drums).

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano, Jazz
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz, Modern
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne, Blues
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar & vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1988, acclaimed Brazilian singer and pianist Tania Maria performed with bassist Leonard Traversa and drummer Kim Plainfield at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Maria is known for her energetic personality and unique style of singing that draws from a variety of jazz, Latin and pop traditions.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano, Jazz
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano. The one-man musical force stunned the audience with his unique vocal percussion as he delved into the crowd for this quirky and charming act.

programme.title: If Only, Concert
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind’ was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022 - Kathrine Windfeld Big Band, Modern
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the bands appearing at jazzahead! 2022 is the Kathrine Windfeld Big Band from Denmark. In pianist, composer and arranger Kathrine Windfeld’s breathtaking compositions, sophisticated harmonic passages meet driving grooves and poetic ballads. Her 15-piece band effortlessly combines playful precision and enthusiastic power. The trumpeters are André Bak, Rolf Thofte Løkke, and Magnus Oseth; the trombonists are Göran Abelli, Tobias Stavngaard, and Anders Larson. The alto saxophonists are Hannes Bennich and Magnus Thuelund; the tenor saxophonists are Roald Elm and Ida Karlsson; the baritone saxophonist is Aske Drasbæk. The rhythm section consists of Viktor Sandström (guitar), Johannes Vaht (double bass), Henrik Holst Hansen (drums), and Kathrine Windfeld (piano).

programme.title: Austin City Limits, R&B
programme.desc: Mixing classic R&B vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound & Color.

programme.title: La nuit des gitans, Jazz
programme.desc: The Royal Conservatoire of Liège hosted a ‘Night of the Gypsies’ at the International Guitar Festival of Liège in 1995. At this occasion, the Raphaël Faÿs Trio and Quintet paid tribute to Romani-Belgian jazz guitarist Django Reinhardt. Raphaël Faÿs (solo guitar), Pierre Blanchard (violin), Daniel Manzanas (guitar), Pablo Gilabert (bass) and Miguel Sanchez (percussion) play Reinhardt’s greatest gypsy jazz hits, including ‘It Had To Be You’, ‘How High The Moon’, ‘Sweet Georgia Brown’, and ‘Minor Swing’. Enjoy Raphaël Faÿs’s fresh take on the light-fingered string sound and swinging rhythms of Django Reinhardt’s gypsy jazz!

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers, Jazz
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

First known for playing with Miles Davis, Scofield shows here that he earned that pedigree.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022 - Francois Bourassa Quartet, Modern
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the performing bands is the François Bourassa Quartet. With ten albums of original music and multiple awards, jazz pianist François Bourassa is an international ambassador for Canada’s thriving jazz community. Taking inspiration from a diversity of sources, this award-winning quartet has been a staple of Montreal’s artistic landscape for a quarter of a century. The band features bassist Guy Boisvert, saxophonist André Leroux and drummer Guillaume Pilote.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown, Jazz
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals. Their December 2010 performance with former backing musicians of Afrobeat founder Fela Kuti in Paris saw them hailed as "the future of Afrobeat".

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne, Jazz
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the duo of Hamilton and Laginha. Grammy-nominated Hamilton de Holanda, who reintroduced the 10-string mandolin in Brazil, teams up with pianist Mário Laginha for stimulating performances of Brazil's musical treasures.

programme.title: Medley, Concert
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Omer Avital Qantar - Jazz in Duketown, Jazz
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences. At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital forms a quintet with saxophonists Asaf Yuria and Alexander Levin, drummer Ofri Nehemya, and pianist Eden Ladin. They present singular repertoire from Avital's album 'Qantar'.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, West Of The West, Concert
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic stretch music; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah’s quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Bassekou Kouyaté, Modern
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ have been collaborating for a series of music programmes: ‘BIRD.tv’, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from the first row! This episode is a fantastic registration of Bassekou Kouyaté, one of the true masters of the ngoni, an ancient traditional lute found throughout West Africa, and he has collaborated with many musicians in and outside of Mali.

programme.title: Carrie Smith, Jazz
programme.desc: Veteran American blues and jazz singer Carrie Smith (1925-2012) was often compared to the legendary Bessie Smith, an artist she greatly admired. She was best known in Europe for her powerful, resonant voice, impeccable timing, and the emotional depth she brought to her songs. Born in Georgia, Carrie Smith began her career singing gospel music and later gained international acclaim as a star of the hit Broadway musical revue Black and Blue. In this concert recording from the Ascona New Orleans Jazz Festival, held in late June and early July 1998 at picturesque Lake Maggiore in Ascona, Switzerland, Smith delivers a captivating performance. Backed by a trio led by pianist Bross Townsend, Smith performs jazz standards by Harold Arlen and George and Ira Gershwin, alongside a string of blues classics including "I'm Tore-Down", "Down Home Blues", "Rock Me Baby", and "Back Water Blues".

programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra - Estival Jazz Lugano, Fusion
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 1, 1986, guitarist John McLaughlin, saxophonist Bill Evans, drummer Danny Gottlieb, pianist Jim Beard, and bassist Jonas Hellborg continued the Mahavishnu Orchestra's sixteen-year legacy of impressive jazz fusion at the Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats, Jazz
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2, Modern
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá’. The batá repertoire - the deep classical music of West Africa - permeates Valdés’ piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés’s band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Mezzoforte - North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, famed Icelandic jazz fusion band Mezzoforte performed for over an hour at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Led by founders Fridrik Karlsson on guitar, Eythor Gunnarsson on keyboard, Jóhann Ásmundsson on bass, and newcomer Dave O'Higgins on saxophone, they play a variety of pieces, including their 1982 hit single "Garden Party".

programme.title: Donna lee, Concert
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform Chicken, Donna Lee, Mr. Phone Bone, and Fannie Mae. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius’s electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Forró Series, Latin
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. Influenced by the music of the past and present, samba collective Samba pros Orixás bridges the gap between tradition and modernity. Naturally, Samba pros Orixás’ repertoire is dominated by sambas, alongside ijexás, jongos, samba de roda, and numerous other infectious Brazilian rhythms that will make you want to move. Don’t miss out their tour-de-force performance!

programme.title: Give It to Him, Concert
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love. In 1980 she enrolled at Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School of Music & Art and Performing Arts in New York City, known from the film 'Fame'. During this time, she appeared as an extra in the legendary comedy film 'Ghostbusters'. Musicals and tours with the bands of Diana Ross and Michael Bolton followed.

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet - Live Concert, Modern
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Duets II: The Great Performances, Jazz
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career. Duets II: The Great Performances is a testament to the artistry and dedication of Tony Bennett, beloved by the performers who sing with him and audiences around the world. Starring Andrea Bocelli, Michael Bublé, Natalie Cole, Sheryl Crow, Aretha Franklin, Josh Groban, Faith Hill, Norah Jones, Lady Gaga, kd lang, John Mayer, Willie Nelson, Alejandro Sanz, Queen Latifah, Carrie Underwood, Amy Winehouse.

programme.title: Live in London 2015, Soul
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Horace Silver - Song for my father, Concert
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays C-Jam Blues in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's Humoresque in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk’s enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition Round About Midnight in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of Sweet and Lovely at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of Sly in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's Song for my Father performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio, Jazz
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians - guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse - accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s Crystal Bells, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include Down and How Deep is the Ocean.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen, Modern
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen. Accompanied by his big band, which included talents such as saxophonist Arnett Cobb, the "King of Vibes" gave an invigorating performance with both mallets and voice.

programme.title: Weekend in LA, Concert
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Joining him to play songs from their joint album "Collaborations" was Grammy award-winning acoustic guitarist Earl Klugh.

programme.title: What'd I Say, Concert
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Gilberto, Gillespie & Skymasters - North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, Dutch big band The Skymasters accompanied monumental jazz trumpet legend Dizzy Gillespie and the Brazilian bossa nova singer Astrud Gilberto at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Straight No Chaser, Concert
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1972, the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam welcomed the Giants of Jazz, an all-star band featuring drummer Art Blakey, trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie, bassist Al McKibbon, pianist Thelonious Monk, saxophonist Sonny Stitt and trombonist Kai Winding. Part 2.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Red Earth, World
programme.desc: American jazz singer and Grammy-winner Dee Dee Bridgewater embarks on a journey through Mali in search of her musical and spiritual roots. Assisted by producer Cheick Tidiane Seck, Dee Dee sets out to discover the ‘traditional’ music of the country, and to collaborate with singers, drummers, ngoni and kora players. She meets and records with celebrated artists, such as ‘jelimusow’ (female griot) Tata Bambo and world-famous ‘wassoulou’ singer Oumou Sangaré. The documentary showcases the particular popularity and strength of female Malian artists who, since the growth of cassette-based music culture in the 1980s, have come to dominate the music scene.

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles, Jazz
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited’ tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano, Jazz
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024, Modern
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead! paid special attention to the jazz scene of the Netherlands and invited over forty jazz acts to perform over the course of three days. Among the bands presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is Sultan Stevenson’s trio. Pianist Stevenson, a Londoner with Caribbean roots, graduated from Conservatory in 2023. He is a rapidly rising talent in the London jazz circuit, whose debut album 'Faithful One' won him the Parliamentary Jazz Award for the best newcomer. Described by The Telegraph as an incipient master, Sultan Stevenson (piano) appears at jazzahead! 2024 with Jacob Gryn (bass) and Joel Waters (drums).

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival, Modern
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne, Jazz
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. His magnificent, burnished baritone can sink into a lyric with luxurious ease, the melody gently sculpted into new shapes at every turn, with the rhythm tugging subtly back and forth across the bar line.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk - Well You Needn't, Concert
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something, Concert
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn’s concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues, Jazz
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. "It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world, she once stated in an interview. The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals. This performance at the French Festival Jazz à Vienne is extra special. Not only because of the beautiful location, but also because she shares the stage with American gospel and blues singer La Velle. Together they give an intimate and beautiful show in the antique theatre of Vienne.

Sjajne željezničke pustolovine s Nickom Knowlesom
programme.desc: Od iskopavanja drevnih rukotvorina do plivanja u ledenom Arktičkom krugu, Nick Knowles putujući vlakom doživljava svjetska čuda. Tijekom šest fantastičnih putovanja svijetom upoznaje ljude, krajolike i kulturu Perua, Meksika, Aljaske, Norveške, Vijetnama i Malezije i vozi se nevjerojatnim vlakovima na nekima od najljepših željezničkih linija na svijetu. U Peruu odlazi na zadivljujuću vožnju čamcem preko jezera Titicaca do plutajućih otoka plemena Uros, a u Meksiku na čarobno putovanje El Chepeom, vlakom koji prolazi kroz Bakreni kanjon. Zatim slijedi pješačenje do ledenjaka Matanuska na Aljasci i noćenje u preuređenom vagonu koji je pretvoren u hotel, parkiranom na napuštenom željezničkom mostu preko rijeke Namsen u Norveškoj. Ova raskošna, energična serija sjajno je istraživanje krajolika, bogatih i siromašnih, nevjerojatnih graditeljskih pothvata i pogleda od kojih vam pamet stane.

programme.desc: Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Svemir sa Tijanom: Misterije svemira
programme.desc: Koliko zapravo poznajemo svemir? Iako su decenije astronomskih istraživanja, brojni teleskopi i svemirske misije značajno proširili naše znanje o kosmosu, ono što razumemo čini tek oko pet procenata njegovog ukupnog sadržaja. Sve ostalo krije neke od najvećih misterija savremene nauke.

programme.title: Eko perspekvive: Zeleni biseri Srbije - zlatni kolut Pirota
Ekologeri: Svi za planinu, planina za sve
programme.desc: Dok mnogi sanjaju život u velikom gradu, Beograđani Milan i Antonija Jevremović pre osam godina doneli su odluku koja im je iz korena promenila život. Užurbani prestonički ritam, saobraćajne gužve i kancelarijske poslove zamenili su mirom obronaka planine Jelice, gde su se sa svojim sinovima preselili na imanje Milanovih predaka u selu Jezdina kod Čačka.

programme.title: UŽIVO: Vaterpolo (ž) - Kup Srbije, finale, prenos
Žene u sportu: Slađana Drezgić
programme.desc: Danas gotovo da nema sportske aktivnosti, Olimpijskih igara, sportskih organizacija, a da tu nema žena. Žena je postala nezaobilazan i značajan faktor o kom god sportu govorili. Kulturni centar
programme.desc: U Fokusu večerašnje emisije je tema odnosa između biografije i fikcije u umetničkoj produkciji. U poslednje vreme smo imali prilike da se sretnemo sa nizom umetničkih dela inspirisanih životima umetnika, pisaca ili naučnika, sa filmovima o Bošku Tokinu, Njegošu, Milevi Ajnštajn, kao i sa predstavama o Jovanu Ćirilovu, Magi Magazinović, Arturu Mileru. Obrade njihovih života predstavljaju različite vidove omaža njihovim delima, a u isto vreme se i nas dubinski tiču, jer pokreću svevremena pitanja, od značenja umetničkog stvaranja, preko odnosa između represije i slobode, do problematike položaja žena, majčinstva i društvene pripadnosti. U ovom Fokusu istražujemo odnos između biografije i fikcije, dokumentarnog i igranog, kao i granica rastegljivosti istine. Da li je ona važnija od umetničke istine?

programme.title: Studio 6: Roentgen Connection
programme.desc: Na programu je savremena muzika za poprečnu flautu, blok flautu i čembalo. Sviraju Karolina Beter i Goška Isfording. Program Silent Songs je inspirisan vokalnom muzikom i idejom - svirati pesme bez reči. Kao što su teoretičari 18. veka, poput Johana Matesona, govorili, instrumentalisti treba da se trude da što bolje imitiraju pevače, te je tako The Roentgen Connectionovu pouku uzeo za moto programa. Zbog toga pored aranžirane vokalne muzike Anje Đorđević i Roderika de Mana, mogu da se čuju kompozicije koje kao osnovu koriste zvučne i retoričke mogućnosti instrumenata.

programme.title: Sterijino pozorje - Sedamdeset godina postojanja
programme.desc: Institucija Sterijinog pozorja je osnovana pre sedamdeset godina, u Novom Sadu, 1956. godine, sa misijom da razvija, podržava i afirmiše domaće dramsko stvaralaštvo. Nastala je u vreme obeležavanja sto pedeset godina od rođenja Jovana Sterije Popovića, jedne od najznačajnijih ličnosti u istoriji srpske kulture, ne samo zbog uticaja koji je imao na dramu i pozorište, već i zbog toga što je pokrenuo osnivanje ključnih nacionalnih institucija, na polju obrazovanja, kulture i nauke.

programme.title: RTS-ov dokumentarac „Srboljub i Hrvoje" pred hrvatskom publikom, film
programme.desc: U Zagrebu je 2019. godine premijerno prikazan film „Srboljub i Hrvoje" našeg novinara Miloša Milića u produkciji RTS-a. Film je snimljen u Nemačkoj, a govori o ljudima koji su postali najbolji prijatelji, iako ih je u životu skoro sve razdvajalo. Projekcija je održana u najstarijem udruženju Srba u Hrvatskoj i privukla je brojnu publiku i novinare. Prvi put zajedno iz Minhena u Zagreb stigli su Srboljub i Hrvoje. Zagrebačka publika u 60-minutnom dokumentarcu čula je šta ih je to u životu razdvajalo, a šta ih je spojilo. Utisci su uglavnom jednoglasni: žalosno je da moramo emigrirati da bi se sastali. I za organizatora filma i za autora isto pitanje: mogu li ovakve priče da pomognu regionu da se pomiri?

programme.title: Mira Adanja Polak: Ekskluzivno - Moć pravog saveta, Ričard Bel
programme.desc: Ričard Bel je čitav svoj radni vek posvetio međunarodnim odnosima i američkoj diplomatskoj službi. Njegov put je nesvakidašnji - počeo je kao mladi volonter Mirovnog korpusa u Jemenu, da bi kroz decenije rada u dvadesetak zemalja stigao do vrha karijere i pozicije ambasadora Sjedinjenih Američkih Država u Obali Slonovače.

programme.title: AProPop: Fotoaparat, serija
programme.desc: Kako li će društvo budućnosti predstavljati globalnu kulturu? Koji predmeti će biti odabrani da budu izloženi javnosti? Da li će to biti ploča Elvisa Preslija? Print Endija Vorhola? Haljina Merilin Monro? Fenomenima popularne kulture bavi se novi serijal AProPop, koji priprema Redakcija za kulturu Kulturno umetničkog programa RTS-a. U deset epizoda, biće reči o fenomenima pop kulture koji su obeležili, svaki na svoj način, svet u kome živimo. Autor serijala: Selina Lovren Aksentić

programme.title: Sajam, jedan život, serija
programme.desc: ,,Sajam, jedan život" je mini dokumentarna serija koja se bavi nastankom i trajanjem jedne od najčuvenijih beogradskih građevina, njenom zadivljujućom strukturom i njenom važnom svrhom.

programme.title: Generacija pobunjenih anđela: Viđeno očinjim vidom, serija
programme.desc: Mlada Bosna je još 1913. godine, i od svojih i od tuđih, najčešće shvatana samo kao pokret omladine željne slobode za potlačene Srbe, Jugoslovene i sve ljude, da bi na Vidovdan 1914. u Sarajevu odjeknuli pucnji zaverenika na prestolonaslednika Carstva, samu personifikaciju ropstva. No, danas se počelo tih pojava, a osobito Mlada Bosna, svodi na opšte podatke, šturu i često netačnu sliku. Od duhovnih uticaja na ove mladiće pominje se nekoliko najpoznatijih, i to samo književne i filozofske vrste, koji većinom imaju političke funkcije - kao dokazni materijal na sarajevskom suđenju i razumevanju same zavere. Televizijska serija Generacija pobunjenih anđela ima pet polučasovnih epizoda: Prolog o kulturi slobode, Viđeno očinjim vidom, Muzika drugih sfera, Od misli do literature, i Avangarda i pucnji koji odjekuju i danas. U seriji govori dvadesetak naučnika koji su specijalizovani za istoriju kulture, umetnosti i ideja sa jedne strane, a sa druge strane za mesto kulturnih fenomena u političkoj, društvenoj i geopolitičkoj istoriji. Autor i reditelj serijala - Miljan GlišićScenario - Miljan Glišić i Zoran StefanovićDirektor fotografije - Zoran RadosavljevićMontaža - Marko Nikolić

programme.title: Gaudeamus, informativni program
programme.desc: Emisija se bavi raznolikim temama iz područja odgoja i obrazovanja u Zadru, Šibeniku i okolici. Ujedno i raspravlja o problemima koji muče učenike, studente, profesore, znanstvenike ali i roditelje. U formi intervjua razgovaramo s osobom koja u djeluje u procesu odgoja i obrazovanja kao i s učenicima, studentima i roditeljima. Želimo potaknuti mlade ljude na stvaralaštvo na medijsku pismenost, na participiranje njih kao mladih ljudi u iznošenju svog mišljenja i ideja. U suradnji s Sveučilištem u Zadru, srednjim i osnovnim školama na području koncesije u emisiji želimo donijeti glas učenika i studenta.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Zerin govori Defne da se Jekta vratio i da se Orhun i Hira neće vjenčati. Afife ponovo ima plan kako Orhuna udaljiti od Hire i Sahre iz vile te odlazi razgovarati s Jektom. Afife nudi da se Jekta sa ženom i kćerkom preseli u vilu. Jekta vidi da Hiru nešto brine, ali ona to negira. Elif sve teže krije svoje osjećaje prema Azizu i sve se čudnije ponaša. Aziz počinje sumnjati da Elifino ponašanje ima veze s njim. Orhun zna da Afifine namjere nisu dobre, ali pristaje na to da se Jekta, Hira i Sahra usele u vilu.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Elif pokušava shvatiti zašto sanja Aziza i odlučuje se držati dalje od njega. Veliki šef zove Gurbuza i traži sastanak s Azizom. Hira je impresionirana Orhunovim zaštitničkim stavom prema Sahri. Jekta sve više uviđa koliko je Sahra vezana za Orhuna. Aziz obavještava načelnika policije o sastanku s velikim šefom i nada se da će se konačno moći vratiti svom normalnom životu. Afife poziva Jektu, Hiru i Sahru na doručak kojem će prisustvovati i Orhun.

programme.title: Od kuće do kuće
programme.desc: Nakon sedam izuzetno uspješnih godina, velike gledanosti i povjerenja publike, došlo je vrijeme za novi korak. Emisija koju su gledaoci godinama poznavali pod nazivom „Zimska kuhinja i „Ljetna kuhinja dobija novo ime, novi vizuelni identitet i novo televizijsko ruho - „Od kuće do kuće. Od „Kuće do kuće je televizijski putopisno-životni format koji Bosnu i Hercegovinu otkriva kroz ljude, njihove domove, rad, tradiciju, hranu i svakodnevni život. Voditelji Almasa i Miran putuju od mjesta do mjesta, od sela do grada, od avlije do avlije tražeći priče koje najbolje govore o zemlji u kojoj živimo. Ne vode ih turističke mape, nego ljudi. Domaćini koji ih dočekaju otvaraju vrata svojih kuća, imanja, radionica, voćnjaka, plastenika i porodičnih poslova i tako postaju glavni junaci svake emisije. Svaka epizoda donosi novo mjesto i nove ljude, ali ostaje vjerna istoj ideji - upoznati Bosnu i Hercegovinu kroz one koji je žive. U središtu formata je bh. čovjek - vrijedan, uporan, gostoljubiv, vezan za svoje mjesto, koji živi od svog rada, čuva ono što je naslijedio, stvara nešto novo, ostaje ili se vraća i svojim životom najbolje pokazuje koliko različitih i vrijednih priča postoji u Bosni i Hercegovini. Od „Kuće do kuće je emisija o zemlji koju poznajemo, ali je još nismo dovoljno upoznali, jer iza svakih vrata postoji priča, a do nje se dolazi - "Od kuće do kuće".

programme.title: Super chef
programme.desc: Četvrta sezona najgledanijeg kulinarskog show programa u BiH, Super chef by Tefal donosi novih 14 takmičara koji se bore za nagradu u vrijednosti od 15.000 KM, ali i prestižnu titulu novog Superchefa. Na tom putu očekuju ih različiti zadaci i izazovi, a sve prati žiri u sastavu Maja Munda Dedović, Severin Terzić i Nihad Mameledžija. Ova sezona je drugačija po novim pravilima, koja podrazumijevaju prvi put igru u parovima, a zadaci su nikad izazovniji.

programme.title: Ljubomora, serija
programme.desc: Nakon što Nalanina otmica Aziza bude razotkrivena, Nuzhet joj zabranjuje da se približava njegovom sinu i upozorava je da više neće tolerisati njene postupke. Mediha u zatvoru pokušava izvršiti samoubistvo, zbog čega Halit i Seniha bivaju zabrinut za njen život i psihičko stanje, te uz Džihanovu pomoć pronalaze način da je vrate kući. Nur pronalazi Mukeremin sakriveni zahtjev za razvod i otkriva da je Nalan prijetnjama spriječila Mukerem da napusti Halita. Bijesan zbog svega kroz šta prolazi njegova majka, Halit pred Nalan iznosi šokantnu tvrdnju o smrti njenog oca.

programme.title: Ispuni mi želju
programme.desc: Emisija Ispuni mi želju, koja usrećuje porodice, djecu, stare i mlade program je za sve generacije. Otvaranje puteva sreće, ličnog zadovoljstva jer smo nekoga učinili sretnim barem na trenutak, osjećaj je koji se ne može mijenjati nijednim drugim. Spoznaja da smo svi zajedno bili dio promjene, otvorili jedan novi prozor u nedodirljivo je apsolutna sloboda, a načini na koji usrećujemo druge su bezbrojni, neograničeni i snažno u konačnici umirujući. Društveno odgovorna osoba, koja predvodi društveno odgovorno poslovanje i čini život ugodnijim ljudima oko sebe sigurno je kvalitetan proizvod zajednice koja ga okružuje. Biti uvijek na strani one ruke koja nas treba je jednostavnost života kojoj svi težimo, a upravo ta savršena jednostvanost čovjeka ispunjava do beskraja, i još dalje. Imati priliku biti na putu dobra, i mogućnosti da se promovirate kroz nemjerljive trenutke radosti jednog života privilegija je onih koji će uvijek i u svemu vidjeti, a na kraju i osjetiti samo uspjeh i zadovoljstvo, kako poslovno tako i lično.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću - Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Kako volim domovinu...
programme.desc: Ljubav prema domovini ne iskazuje se samo riječima i simbolima, već spremnošću da čuvamo ono što smo naslijedili, gradimo ono što ćemo ostaviti budućim generacijama i svojim djelima doprinosimo njenoj snazi, dostojanstvu i trajanju. Domovina nije samo zemlja kojoj pripadamo - ona je odgovornost koju nosimo, vrijednosti koje čuvamo i budućnost koju zajedno stvaramo. A kako volimo domovinu? Upravo onako kako je živimo, čuvamo i gradimo - svakog dana, svojim djelima.

programme.title: Dobar dan BIH
programme.desc: Cilj emisije "Dobar dan BiH", koju radnim danima gledate na Hayat TV, prije svega jeste potaknuti pozitivne promjene u društvu, kod pojedinaca, ali i sistemske promjene. Ukazujemo na probleme, ne samo kako bismo informisali o njima, nego kako bismo podstakli razmišljanje i u konačnici ponudili rješenja. Radimo to dajući prostor ljudima koji su stručni za uske oblasti i koji su pozvani da savjetuju, kako vlast, tako i građane. Uvijek ističemo pozitivne priče i tragamo za njima kako bismo bili podrška onima koji su uspješni, ali i motiv drugima da pokušaju uspjeti. U našoj emisiji, pored poznatih lica iz svijeta politike, ekonomije, sporta, kulture, iz naše zemlje i svijeta, prostor nerijetko imaju medijski nepromovisane osobe, koje svojim "ljudskim" pričama i iskustvima obogaćuju sadržaj i daju vlastiti osvrt na ono što je njihov uspjeh ili problem.

programme.title: Ljubomora, serija
programme.desc: Nakon što Halit pred Nalan iznese optužbu da su Nuzhet i Nur ubili njenog oca Envera, ona počinje preispitivati okolnosti njegove smrti. Halit traži Senihinu pomoć kako bi dokazao da je Enver ubijen i tako spasio Medihu, dok Nur upozorava Nalan da će, ako ode u policiju, zauvijek izgubiti mjesto u njihovoj porodici. U međuvremenu, Mediha se teško nosi s traumama iz zatvora, a Halit čini sve da joj olakša povratak normalnom životu. Dok se Mukerem i Nuzhet suočavaju s novim iskušenjima, Nalan odlučuje sama potražiti odgovore i odlazi na vrata koja bi mogla promijeniti sve.

U polusatnom formatu, sa relevantnim gostima iz zemlje, regije i svijeta, analizirimo najaktuelnije teme i događaje. „7plus vam svaki dan donosi više od informacija - daje vam širi kontekst vijesti, ukazuje na uzroke problema i traga za rješenjima. programme.title: Kratko i slatko by Dolcela
programme.desc: Jesen i zima donose posebnu čaroliju u naše domove, mirise cimeta, vanilije, čokolade, pečenih jabuka, oraha i toplih, tek pripremljenih slastica. To je vrijeme kada se češće okupljamo u kuhinji, dijelimo omiljene okuse i male trenutke zadovoljstva. Upravo u toj atmosferi nastaje „Kratko i slatko by Dolcela, emisija posvećena ljubavi prema slasticama, kreativnosti i uživanju u svakom zalogaju. Kroz ovu slatku priču vodi nas chef Miran Karić, koji će petkom i subotom pripremati neodoljive slastice, otkrivati male slastičarske tajne i pokazivati kako uz kvalitetne sastojke i malo mašte svaka kuhinja može postati mjesto pravog slatkog užitka. Posebnost emisije je i druženje s gostima iz svijeta kulture, umjetnosti, medija i javnog života. Subotom će Miran svoje slastice pripremati i dijeliti s gostima, uz razgovore, zanimljive priče, uspomene i mnogo dobrog raspoloženja. A da bi se i gledaoci mogli pridružiti ovoj slatkoj avanturi, svakog četvrtka Miran će najaviti slasticu koja nas očekuje tokom vikenda, predstaviti precizne sastojke i količine te otkriti sve što je potrebno nabaviti kako bi se priprema mogla pratiti i kod kuće. Tako vikend postaje prilika da zajedno kuhamo, učimo i uživamo u slatkim rezultatima. Gledajte Kratko i slatko by Dolcela jer najljepše slastice nisu samo one koje pripremamo, već i trenuci, ljudi i uspomene koje dijelimo uz njih.

programme.title: Pravo vrijeme
programme.desc: Pravo vrijeme - emisija koja donosi iskrene razgovore, dobre vibracije i ljude koji stvaraju muziku, glumce, producente, sportiste i mnoge druge iz kulture i show biznisa. Svake sedmice u studiju su lica koja ostavljaju trag - govore otvoreno o svom putu, inspiraciji i svakodnevici iza reflektora. Tu su i ekskluzivni nastupi, premijere, spontani momenti i priče koje se rijetko čuju.

programme.title: Orhan, serija
programme.desc: Orhan-beg kreće u obračun s Temurtašem nakon što Ilhanidi zauzmu njegov pogranični logor, a Delidže-beg prividnom odanošću priprema zamku za neprijatelja. Dok se Fatma bori s bolom zbog Flavijeve izdaje, Orhanovi sinovi odlaze u prvo veliko iskušenje, a Aladin-beg dobija zadatak da drži Asporču pod kontrolom tokom opsade Iznika. Temurtaš sklapa savez s bizantskim zavjerenicima i pokreće napad na Orhanovu vojsku, ali njegov plan pada u vodu kada se otkrije zavjera protiv bizantskog cara, zbog čega bježi u Crnu šumu. Orhan naređuje da se Temurtaš progoni, a Aladina šalje u Konstantinopolj da iskoristi sukob za prijestolje i osigura nove teritorije za osmansku državu.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Halil napada Zejnep jer mu se miješa u posao. Selma shvata zašto je policija privela Erena, te se suočava s Kijmet. Zejnep donosi iznenađujuću odluku zbog koje se Halil pretvara u njenog ljutog protivnika. Halil saznaje da je Tulaj ponovo umiješala prste u njegove poslove, ali ispostavlja se da ta informacija nije tačna. Kijmet dovodi Erena u nezgodnu situaciju pred Selmom pričom o njegovoj zaručnici. Selma, bijesna, izbacuje Erena iz kuće.

programme.title: Saladin, serija
programme.desc: Nuredin saznaje zašto je njegov plan osvajanja Damaska propao. Nuredin daje Mevdudinu šansu da ispravi svoje greške, ali on to odbija. Salahudin dolazi u Askalon po materijale potrebne za opsadu Damaska. Nuredinov položaj se dodatno komplikuje dolaskom Melikinog brata.

programme.desc: Dve žene beže u pustinju Novog Meksika ne bi li se izvukle iz kandži zloglasne sekte. (The Aviary, 2022.)

programme.title: Umorstva u Midsomeru, serija
programme.desc: Ništa nije onakvim kakvim se čini iza lijepo podšišanih živica simpatičnih ladanjskih kuća engleskoga Midsomera. Ispod mirne površine uspavanog seoskog života nalaze se mračne tajne, skandali i zlo. Ubojstvo, otmica i ucjena nisu neuobičajene među ekscentričnim stanovnicima Midsomera. "Umorstva u Midsomeru" televizijska je serija o suvremenim kriminalističkim pričama utemeljena na liku inspektora Barnabyja kojeg je u svojim romanima vješto opisala Caroline Graham, spisateljica koju "Sunday Times" naziva novom Agathom Christie. U svakoj epizodi spokoj mjestašaca u Midsomeru potrese neki zločin. Gotovo svi stanovnici potencijalni su sumnjivci koje samo inspektor Barnaby (John Nettles) i njegov vjerni pomoćnik narednik Troy (Daniel Casey) mogu uz marljiv rad postepeno oslobađati sumnje i pronaći pravog krivca. Uz već poznatu glumačku postavu u seriji se pojavljuje i nekoliko svjetski afirmiranih glumaca: Orlando Bloom, Prunella Scales, Richard Briers, Lynda Bellingham, Trudi Styler, Frank Windslor, Phyllida Law i dr. "Umorstva u Midsomeru" kriminalistička je serija s najdužim stažem prikazivanja na malim ekranima, a prate je gledatelji u 164 države, po čemu je jedna od naprodavanijih britanskih serija.

programme.title: GLAZBENA PANORAMA, najljepša ulica na svijetu uživo
programme.desc: Uz biranu glazbu i pogled na najljepšu ulicu na svijetu (Stradun), gledatelji Libertas televizije uživo promatraju Grad i s njegove najviše kote - tvrđave Imperijal na Srđu. Objektivi kamere 'zoom-iraju' kamenu školjku koju oplakuje more, Boninovo, Lapad ili Gruž. U jutarnjim satima i za lijepa vremena objektiv kamere pokazuje Elafite, Pelješac, Mljet, a nekad se vidi i Lastovo. Izlazak sunca nad Konavlima ili svitanje iznad Župskoga zaljeva gledatelji mogu uživo vidjeti i kad moraju ostati doma. Emitiranjem programa putem aplikacije za mobilne telefone LTV TO GO i na internetskoj stranici www.libertas.tv dubrovačka svitanja omogućujemo našim gledateljima i u najudaljenijim zemljama.

programme.title: VIJESTI
programme.desc: informativna emisija s prijevodom na znakovni jezik Vijesti Libertas televizije središnja su informativna emisija koja svakodnevno (od ponedjeljka do petka) donosi cjelovite, pravodobne i provjerene informacije. Kroz Vijesti progovaramo o problemima Dubrovnika i Dubrovačko-neretvanske županije. Građanima omogućujemo ostvarivanje prava na javno informiranje njegujući kulturnu raznolikost i dubrovačku baštinu uz poštivanje nacionalne, rasne, spolne i vjerske ravnopravnosti. Uz aktualne, a lokalne teme u Vijestima pratimo društveno-politički, kulturni i sportski život dubrovačke regije. U svakodnevnom smo kontaktu s gledateljima jer mišljenje građana nam je najvažnije.

Uz točno vrijeme i podatke o temperaturi zraka i mora, u dnu ekrana emitiramo niz informativnih sadržaja. programme.title: JUTARNJI PROGRAM, koktel vijesti, servisnih informacija, zabave i glazbe
programme.desc: Jutarnji program Libertas televizije mozaična je emisija koju čini niz informativnih i zabavnih sadržaja, uz biranu glazbu i kadrove s panoramskih kamera postavljenih na gradskom zvoniku i tvrđavi Imperijal. Dežurni voditelj iz novinarske redakcije LTV-a, u formatu radijskog voditelja gledatelje informira o vijestima iz društvenog života, kulture i sporta te objavljuje korisne informacije komunalnih tvrtki, stanje u cestovnom, pomorskom i zračnom prometu. Kroz Jutarnji program najavljujemo sva važna događanja u Dubrovačkoj regiji, programe kulturnih institucija i festivala. U program se svakodnevno javljaju i novinarske ekipe s terena, a emisija je otvorena i za pozive gledatelja koje povremeno darivamo ulaznicama i sl. poklonima. Redovite tjedne rubrike rezervirane su za naše dopisnike iz Konavala i Župe, s Pelješca, Korčule, povremeno i drugih otoka. Redovite rubrike imaju dopisici iz doline Neretve, a povremene dubrovački iseljenici iz raznih krajeva svijeta.

Shakespeare - Uspon genija
programme.desc: Trodijelna dokumentarna serija posvećena Bardu. Ljubav, sukob, obitelj - nitko ih od njega nije bolje obradio. Glumačke legende dijele svoja razmišljanja o najvećem piscu svih vremena - i opasnom, uzbudljivom svijetu koji je rasplamsao njegovu kreativnost. Serija razjašnjava Shakespeareovu karijeru i analizira njegovu osobnu i profesionalnu povijest. Priča o njegovu životu koju kazuju mnogi stručnjaci ispresijecana je dramskim vinjetama koje prikazuju ključne trenutke njegova života. Ovo je nevjerojatna priča o tome kako je rukavičarev sin postao najveći pisac svih vremena. Shakespeareov kreativni genij krijepio se opasnim i uzbudljivim svijetom ispunjenim žučnim rivalstvima, pobunom, ubojstvom i smrtonosnom kugom. Serija je snimljena u povodu 400. obljetnice prvog folio izdanja Williama Shakespearea.

Jurski park 2, film
programme.desc: Četiri je godine prošlo od tragično okončanog prvog posjeta Jurskom parku na otoku Isla Nublar nedaleko Kostarike. Nakon prvog iskustva s prapovijesnim životinjama, karijera nekad cijenjenog matematičara Iana Malcolma (J. Goldblum) sad se nalazi pod znakom pitanja. Kad posjeti umirovljenog milijardera Johna Hammonda (R. Attenborough), utemeljitelja fondacije InGen, Ian sazna za postojanje još jednog Jurskog parka, ovaj put na otoku Isla Sornar. Dok je park na otoku Isla Nublar bio samo atrakcija za turiste, dinosauri su uzgajani na drugom otoku gdje i danas žive neometani od ljudi. Nažalost, te je činjenice otkrio Howardov nećak Peter Ludlow (A. Howard), koji namjerava dinosaure uloviti i prebaciti u park u San Diegu u Kaliforniji. Ian isprva ne želi prihvatiti Hammondovu ponudu da sudjeluje u ekspediciji koja bi trebala zaustaviti njegova nećaka, ali se smjesta predomisli kad dozna da se na otoku već nalazi njegova djevojka, paleontolog Sarah Harding (J. Moore). Dok na otok kreće u društvu snimatelja dokumentarnih filmova Nicka Van Owena (V. Vaughn) i tehnologa Eddiea Carra (R. Schiff), Ian ne zna da se njihovoj ekspediciji samovoljno pridružila i Ianova zapostavljena kći Kelly (V. Lee Chester). No na otoku su i ljudi Howardova nećaka, predvođeni iskusnim lovcem Rolandom Temboom (P. Postlethwaite). Želeći pomoći ozlijeđenom mladunčetu, Sarah i Ian ne slute da će time izazvati reakciju njegovih roditelja, te sve članove ekspedicije dovesti u smrtnu opasnost...

programme.title: Jurski park 2, film
programme.desc: Četiri je godine prošlo od tragično okončanog prvog posjeta Jurskom parku na otoku Isla Nublar nedaleko Kostarike. Nakon prvog iskustva s prapovijesnim životinjama, karijera nekad cijenjenog matematičara Iana Malcolma (J. Goldblum) sad se nalazi pod znakom pitanja. Kad posjeti umirovljenog milijardera Johna Hammonda (R. Attenborough), utemeljitelja fondacije InGen, Ian sazna za postojanje još jednog Jurskog parka, ovaj put na otoku Isla Sornar. Dok je park na otoku Isla Nublar bio samo atrakcija za turiste, dinosauri su uzgajani na drugom otoku gdje i danas žive neometani od ljudi. Nažalost, te je činjenice otkrio Howardov nećak Peter Ludlow (A. Howard), koji namjerava dinosaure uloviti i prebaciti u park u San Diegu u Kaliforniji. Ian isprva ne želi prihvatiti Hammondovu ponudu da sudjeluje u ekspediciji koja bi trebala zaustaviti njegova nećaka, ali se smjesta predomisli kad dozna da se na otoku već nalazi njegova djevojka, paleontolog Sarah Harding (J. Moore). Dok na otok kreće u društvu snimatelja dokumentarnih filmova Nicka Van Owena (V. Vaughn) i tehnologa Eddiea Carra (R. Schiff), Ian ne zna da se njihovoj ekspediciji samovoljno pridružila i Ianova zapostavljena kći Kelly (V. Lee Chester). No na otoku su i ljudi Howardova nećaka, predvođeni iskusnim lovcem Rolandom Temboom (P. Postlethwaite). Želeći pomoći ozlijeđenom mladunčetu, Sarah i Ian ne slute da će time izazvati reakciju njegovih roditelja, te sve članove ekspedicije dovesti u smrtnu opasnost...

programme.title: Jezgra, film
programme.desc: Geofizičar dr. Josh Keyes (Aaron Eckhart) došao je do nevjerojatnog otkrića: Zemljina unutarnja jezgra prestala se okretati! Elektromagnetsko polje se poremetilo i Zemlja će nestati za nekoliko mjeseci. Postoji samo jedno rješenje: tim najboljih svjetskih znanstvenika mora krenuti u središte Zemlje. Budućnost čovječanstva je neizvjesna, a hrabri znanstvenici moraju učiniti nezamislivo: aktivirati nuklearni eksploziv kako bi reaktivirali jezgru.

programme.title: Početak kraja, film
programme.desc: Vatikan, 1979. Sveti Otac (M. Margolis) prima obavijest da će upravo biti rođena djevojčica za koju proročanstvo tvrdi da će za dvadeset godina postati Sotoninom nevjestom. Rođenje njihovog djeteta označit će kraj čovječanstva... New York, dvadeset godina kasnije. Cijela je zemlja u iščekivanju dolaska 2000. godine pri čemu se jedni raduju neviđenom slavlju, a drugi upozoravaju na moguće probleme. Bivši policajac Jericho Cane (A. Schwarzenegger) na rubu je samoubojstva otkako je tragično izgubio obitelj. Sa svojim partnerom Bobbyjem (K. Pollak) radi kao stručnjak za sigurnost i zbog depresije sve više pije. Kad u gradu zaredaju neobične nesreće, Jericho se nađe usred ostvarenja proročanstva koje kaže da će Sotona (G. Byrne) uoči dolaska 2000. godine potražiti novu nevjestu. To je dvadesetogodišnja Christine York (R. Tunney) koja godinama pati od strašnih vizija... Iako su u drugoj polovici devedesetih zaredali apokaliptični filmovi katastrofe, malo se filmova bavilo konkretnim prijelazom u novi milenij ili barem 2000. godinom. Jedan je od tih rijetkih projekata povratnički film Arnolda Schwarzeneggera (Istinite laži, serijal Terminator), snimljen nakon njegovih višegodišnjih problema sa srcem, ali i debakla s "Batmanom i Robinom" (1997). Osmišljen kao glumčev povratak mračnijim zapletima, "End of Days" trebao je s jedne strane zaintrigirati kao uznemirujuća vizija skorog završetka 20. stoljeća, a s druge kao spoj misterije, akcije i strave u kojem će šira publika pronaći nešto po svom ukusu. Za redatelja je angažiran stručnjak za znanstvenu fantastiku Peter Hyams (2010: Druga Odiseja, Vremenski policajac), a scenarij je napisao Andrew W. Marlowe (Air Force One, Čovjek bez tijela). Policajca "na rubu" tumači Schwarzenegger dok je Sotonu utjelovio G. Byrne (Privedite osumnjičene, Stigmata) efektno se poigravši s mogućnostima takvog lika. Između njih našla se mlada R. Tunney, slavodobitnica u Veneciji (Niagara, Niagara), dok su u ostalim ulogama K. Pollak, zatim TV zvijezda CCH Pounder (serije Na rubu zakona i Hitna služba) te pokojni oskarovac R. Steiger (U vrelini noći, Na dokovima New Yorka). Redatelj Hyams nije se ustručavao šokantnijih prizora, ni što se tiče nasilja, ni što se tiče erotike (uz to, filmovi mu plijene osebujnom fotografijom s obzirom da pri snimanju preferira prirodno svjetlo).

programme.title: Gorski spašavatelji, serija
programme.desc: Nakon smrti svog najboljeg prijatelja Stefana, Andreas Marthaler zatekne se na njegovu seoskom imanju. Prijatelju je bio obećao da će se skrbiti za Emilie i njihovo dvoje djece. No isprva se s tim ne slažu ni Emilie ni Andreasova djevojka Sarah. Tako se ekstremni alpinist, Andreas Markthaler, na početku serije nađe protiv svoje volje između dviju žena. Ali Gorska služba spašavanja nije samo Andreas Markthaler. On je dio ekipe čiji se članovi uvijek mogu osloniti jedni na druge. No to nipošto ne znači da u toj maloj obitelji uvijek vlada sklad. Tu je, primjerice, Tobias Herbrechter. Nakon Stefanove tragične pogibije on preuzima vodstvo GSS-a. Doduše, misli da se uvijek iznova mora opravdavati osobito pred Andreasom. Bea Kleinert je primalja, zadužena za pružanje medicinske prve pomoći, i voli pilota helikoptera, Michaela Dörflera. Ali on je oženjen. I tu je još Toni Stössel, vlasnik trgovine sportske opreme, koji je uvijek vedre ćudi.

programme.title: Keine Talkshow - Eingesperrt mit Jan Fleischhauer
Keine Talkshow - Eingesperrt mit Jan Fleischhauer
Crna kutija, film
programme.desc: Mathieu je talentirani mladi analitičar crne kutije u misiji da riješi razlog smrtonosnog pada potpuno novog zrakoplova. Ipak, kad vlasti zatvore slučaj, Mathieu se ne može oteti dojmu da s dokazima nešto nije u redu. Dok ponovno preslušava snimku, počinje otkrivati neke ozbiljno uznemirujuće detalje. Može li se snimka modificirati? Idući protiv zapovijedi svog šefa, Mathieu započinje vlastitu istragu - opsesivnu i opasnu potragu za istinom koja će brzo ugroziti mnogo više od njegove karijere ...

programme.title: Betty i njezine dijagnoze, serija
programme.desc: Betty i njezine dijagnoze je njemačka serija medicinske tematike, viđena očima medicinskih sestara sa snažnim ženskim likom u središtu. To je odlučna i sposobna sestra Bettina Betty Dewald, zaposlena u Karlovoj klinici u Aachenu, koja se bori za pacijente, a protiv bolničkog sustava. Pritom se redovito sukobljava s dr. Marcom Behringom kojeg izaziva izravnošću. Za nju liječnici nisu bogovi u bijelom. Ona kaže što misli, a čini što kaže. Kad liječnik na brzinu istrese pacijentu u lice gomilu stručnih izraza, pomaže samo netko tko će si uzeti vremena i objasniti mu liječnikovu dijagnozu. Upravo to radi medicinska sestra Betty.

programme.title: Michel bringt die Welt in Ordnung
Michel bringt die Welt in Ordnung
Grubzon, animirani film
programme.desc: "Grubzon" je prekrasan britanski crtani film snimljen prema nagrađivanoj knjizi za djecu Julije Donaldson "The Gruffalo". Priča je to o doživljajima jednog miša u šumi, a ideja potječe od stare kineske narodne priče. Knjiga koju je ilustrirao Alex Scheffler prodana je u više od 10 milijuna primjeraka, osvojila niz nagrada za dječju književnost, a prema njoj su napravljene predstave i na Broadwayju i West Endu. Objavljena 1999. u Velikoj Britaniji, priča ima oko 700 riječi i namijenjena je djeci od tri do sedam godina. A priča je to o mišu koji u šumi susreće životinje, redom jače od njega, koje ga svakako žele pojesti. No miš će ih sve nadmudriti i lukavstvom izbjeći zlu sudbinu. Lisica, sova i zmija pozivaju ga na večeru. Miš, naravno, zna tko bi bio glavno jelo, stoga smišlja priču o tome kako će večerati sa svojim prijateljem grubzonom, najstrašnijim bićem u šumi, čudovištem koje je pola grizli, a pola bizon. Grabežljivci, naravno, odustaju, no miš će se naći u velikom čudu kad usred šume ugleda pravog pravcatog - grubzona! Ako mislite da se miš tada prestrašio, prevarili ste se! A pogledajte što je tek uslijedilo....

programme.title: In the Dark - Wer übersteht die Nacht?
Simpsoni
programme.desc: Simpsoni su najdulja animirana serija emitirana u prime timeu u povijesti američkih televizija i najdulja takva humoristična serija, pa su postali kulturna institucija. Simpsoni žive u gradiću Springfieldu. Homer je sigurnosni inspektor u tamošnjoj nuklearnoj elektrani. Marge pokušava održati mir u obitelji. Bart je nestašan desetogodišnjak. Osmogodišnja Lisa je inteligentni vegetarijanac koji svira saksofon, a djetešce Maggie emocije izražava pomoću dudice. Gledatelji su također zavoljeli bogat i ponekad osobenjački svijet ostalih stanovnika Springfielda. Nekoliko je glumaca dalo glasove Simpsonima i drugim stanovnicima Springfielda: Homeru, Krustyju, Djedici. Barneyju, gradonačelniku Quimbyju i podvorniku Willieju (Dan Castellaneta); Marge, Patty i Selmi (Julie Kavner); Bartu, Nelsonu i Ralphu Wiggumu (Nancy Cartwright); Lisi (Yeardley Smith); Moeu, Apuu, šefu policije Wiggumu, profesoru Frinku, skupljaču stripova i dr. Nicku Rivieri (Hank Azaria); te g. Burnsu, Smithersu, Nedu Flandersu, predstojniku škole Skinneru, velečasnom Lovejoyu i Kentu Brockmanu (Harry Shearer).

programme.title: Kako sam upoznao vašu majku, serija
programme.desc: Bez nekog posebnog povoda ostarjeli Ted Mosby (Josh Radnor) jednog je dana posjeo kćer i sina kako bi im potanko ispričao niz događaja koji su prethodili upoznavanju njega i njihove majke. Kako bi što podrobnije opisao što je naumio, Ted se s ponosom prisjetio vremena iz mladih dana kada je obožavao svoj posao arhitekta, ali i samački život koji je živio. Obzirom da nije imao stalnu djevojku, svaki je slobodni trenutak provodio sa svojim najboljim prijateljima iz Wesleyan sveučilišta: studentom prava Marshalom Eriksenom (Jason Segel) i dječjom odgajateljicom Lily Aldrin (Alyson Hannigan), koji su svoju dugogodišnju vezu odlučili okruniti brakom. Upravo je taj događaj potaknuo Teda da napokon krene u akciju. U ozbiljnoj potrazi za „srodnom dušom", Tedu rado pomaže i mudri Barney Stinson (Neil Patrick Harris), najzabavniji dio četveročlane ekipe. Budući da je Barney okorjeli ženskaroš koji zna kako pristupiti nježnijem spolu, Ted će lako upoznavati mnoge djevojke, no sama sudbina naći će mu onu pravu, koja će biti majka njegove djece...

programme.title: The Middle, serija
programme.desc: Patricia Heaton igra Frankie Heck u ovoj toploj i duhovitoj humorističnoj seriji o podizanju obitelji i spuštanju očekivanja. Sredovječna pripadnica srednjeg staleža i stanovnica gradića u unutrašnjosti države, Frankie Heck, preopterećena je i zaposlena majka troje djece koja s pomoću svog ironičnog smisla za humor nastoji s obitelji preživjeti svaki dan. Njezin flegmatični suprug Mike menadžer je lokalnoga kamenoloma i njezin podrugljivi partner u svakodnevnim mukama podizanja njihove prosječne - da, svakako prosječne - obitelji. Dok žongliraju dolaskom na posao na vrijeme i kupnjom instant-večera koje jedu pred TV-om, Frankie i Mike odgajaju svoju djecu s ljubavlju i čvrstom srednjozapadnjačkom praktičnošću. Axl je najstariji, tinejdžer i sportaš koji je nekako uspio upisati fakultet sa stipendijom iz footballa. Zatim je tu Sue, njihova neobično obična i vječno optimistična kći tinejdžerica koja u svemu čega se primi slavno propadne - iako se uspjela domoći fakulteta. Na kraju imamo Bricka, otkačenog učenika srednje škole koji opsesivno čita i šapuće sebi u bradu.
